base.description: The pack everything not named below comes from.

diffuse.description: The pack the color maps of the whole body come from.

normal.description: The pack the normal maps of the whole body come from.

subsurface.description: The pack the subsurface (skin tint) maps of the whole body come from.

specular.description: The pack the specular maps of the whole body come from.

head.description: The pack the head takes its files from first. Without it, the head follows the body.

headNormal.description: The pack the head's normal map comes from. It comes before head.

teeth.description: The pack the mouth textures (actors\character\mouth) come from.

parts.description: The parts of the skin the rule sets: diffuse, normal, subsurface and specular for the whole body, head, headNormal, teeth. Without it, the whole skin, with the pack's other files (face detail maps, elders' maps).

sex.description: Only NPCs of this sex. Without it, both.

faction.description: Only NPCs in one of these factions.

plugin.description: Only NPCs added or changed by one of these plugins.

npcFormID.description: Only these NPCs, by plugin and FormID.

weight.description: Only NPCs whose weight is in [min, max], from 0 to 100, both ends included.

vampire.description: true: only vampires. false: no vampires. Without it, both.

obodyPreset.description: Only NPCs whose OBody preset is one of these BodySlide presets, by the name in the preset file. Needs OBody NG.

skins.description: The packs or mixes the rule gives, one per NPC. "*" is every skin with body color maps for the NPC's sex.

gameSkin.description: true: the parts the rule sets keep the game's textures, in place of skins.

off.description: true: the rule is switched off.

skinRules.description: Named rules, read from top to bottom: each part of an NPC's skin comes from the first rule that fits the NPC and sets that part. Parts no rule sets come from a random skin. A skin picked in the OSkin menu replaces the rules for that NPC.

blacklistedSkinsFromRandomDistribution.description: The packs or mixes random skins never give. Rules can still name them.

blacklistedSkinsShowInMenu.description: Whether the skins left out of random skins, or of a rule's "*" by exceptSkins, still show in the Skins tab, to be picked by hand.

skinMixes.description: Named mixes of packs. A mix takes each part it names from that pack, and everything else from its base. A mix can't use a pack's name. Wherever a skin name goes, it can be a pack or a mix.

menuHotkey.description: The key that opens the OSkin menu, as a DirectX scan code (37 is K). 0 is no key, the menu still opens from SKSE Menu Framework.

disableSkinDistribution.description: Turns the rules off for a sex, or for everyone. Valid values: "none", "male", "female", "all". Skins picked in the menu stay.

playerFollowsRules.description: true: the player gets skins from the rules like an NPC, unless one was picked in the menu. false: only rules that name the player (Skyrim.esm 00000007 in npcFormID) apply to them.
